answer_4.quote: We evaluate IRN and some strong baselines on TV dataset. Given an input DAs, we ask human evaluator to score generated surface realizations from our model and other baselines in terms of informativeness and naturalness.
answer_4.guideline: Here informativeness measures whether output utterance contains all the information specified in the DA without insertion of extra slots or missing an input slot. The naturalness is defined as whether it mimics a response from a human (both ratings are out of 5).
